bugs_found: review-validate/review-gate branch fallback accepts path traversal via branch name, allowing reads outside .claude/reviews
all continues after profile-validate failure and later checks use unvalidated profile objects, so malformed .banking-profile can crash or run with bad assumptions
contract-validate/review-validate/review-gate load schema and JSON files without configuration-error handling, causing uncaught exceptions instead of documented exit code 2
review-gate dedupes findings by sorted filename order, not by actual round chronology; lexicographic round-10 can be overwritten by older round-2, producing wrong resolution status
contract-presence treats any contract block with matching name anywhere in the file as covering a function, so duplicate functions or misplaced/stale contracts can falsely pass
contract-validate silently ignores unreadable or non-UTF8 sensitive files, allowing invalid or missing contracts to pass without a failure
unsupported non-Python files in contract-presence and unknown extensions in floats-check are warnings only, so sensitive code can bypass required contract and money precision gates
floats-check misses direct float literals and arithmetic in money paths, so precision-loss risks can pass the CI gate
